name: Yanagi Fumiko
source:
Fumiko is a student in broadcasting club who is very social and loves having fun. She is clumsy, running into the protagonist for many times. She loves cute stuff and considers herself a cute person. Sometimes, she is seen dressed in an animal mascot walking around the school. Despite her small figure, Fumiko is fond of eating. She is also scared easily, so it is not a good idea to bring her to places like haunted mansions.

[Taken from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tokimeki_Memorial_4]Wikipedia[/url].]
